In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the Bjerrum theory is not a good approximation for the restricted primitive model, although the degree of ion pairing it implies may not be far wrong.
the Bjerrum theory, while not quantitatively accurate, provides a useful and convenient approximation to the more accurate HNC theory.
the HNC calculations show that Bjerrum's ion pairing theory gives a qualitatively correct description of the ion-ion pair distribution functions, but not a quantitatively correct one.

the HNC calculations are consistent with the Bjerrum theory and with the experimental data.

the Bjerrum theory is not a good description of ion-ion pair correlation function, and that it does not describe the ion-ion pair distribution function well.
